expectations.text: Report has an explicit verdict line (PASS/FAIL) near the top
Report identifies all three books and their roles (user, operator, tester)
Report mentions that the root README.md says 'both guides' or omits the tester guide
Report does not flag '# comment' lines inside bash code blocks as extra H1 headings
Report does not list any broken relative link (there are none) as an error
Report separates must-fix failures from judgement-call deviations or suggestions
expectations.evidence: Headings: Verdict / What was checked / Per-part findings / Cross-cutting / Summary of action items. Findings are grouped by book, not split into must-fix vs judgement calls.
